verdict.rationale: Attio markets a built-in assistant, "Ask Attio", that searches, updates and creates with AI, drafts follow-ups, updates records, schedules next steps, creates account briefs, and builds workflows from a described goal. Native agents (Web, Scoring, Routing, Custom) also run inside workflows, so tasks are delegated to in-product AI rather than external tools. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the assistant's capabilities and limits (all evidence is marketing-page copy), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as described.
